title: verbs for actions
rule: Lead with a verb (or a specific verb phrase) for commands that initiate an action or submit information; prefer a specific verb over a generic Next.
pass_when: Action/submit commands lead with a verb or specific verb phrase, not a generic Next.
fail_when: Noun-only or generic Next where a specific verb is available.
overview: Action/submit commands lead with a verb or specific verb phrase, not a generic Next.
not_when: Not for delete / discard / confirm, or unsaved leave.
agent_hint: Lead with a verb (or a specific verb phrase) for commands that initiate an action or submit information.
description: Lead with a verb (or a specific verb phrase) for commands that initiate an action or submit information. Action/submit commands lead with a verb or specific verb phrase, not a generic Next. It fails when Noun-only or generic Next where a specific verb is available.
